tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Normalization of the limiting cylinder's curvature] For the cylinder obtained at infinity in the positively curved three-dimensional case, the scalar curvature of $(S^2,h(-1))$ is $1$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Existence for all $t<0$ gives the upper bound $1$. Since $R$ is increasing along gradient lines, $\inf R_g>0$ and the self-similar flow has $\inf R_{G(t)}=(\inf R_g)/|t|\to \infty $ as $t\uparrow 0$. Hence the limiting sphere becomes singular at zero, forcing equality.

□
